items.source: Note that the time period includes execution of the test method itself, any repetitions of the test, and any set up or tear down of the test fixture.
items.translation: 注意，该时间段包括测试方法本身的执行、任何重复以及测试夹具的任何设置或清理。

items.source:
If the test execution takes longer than the specified time period, then
the test is considered to have failed.
items.translation: 如果测试执行时间超过指定时间段，则视为测试失败。

items.source:
The maximum amount of time (in milliseconds) that a test execution can
take without being marked as failed due to taking too long.
items.translation: 测试执行在不因耗时过长而被标记为失败的情况下，允许花费的最大时间（以毫秒为单位）。

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations.
items.translation: 此注解可用作 元注解 来创建自定义的 组合注解。

items.source: since Spring Framework 7.0 in favor of the SpringExtension and JUnit Jupiter
items.translation: 自 Spring Framework 7.0 起，推荐使用 SpringExtension 和 JUnit Jupiter。
罗德·约翰逊，萨姆·布拉南
